top_choice_rationale: P001 awards Katori and Ye for a separable invention, magic-wavelength trapping of many neutral atoms, and its realisation at the 10^-18 level. The work is mature and independently reproduced in Sr and Yb at several national laboratories, and it has delivered physics results (millimetre-scale gravitational redshift, bounds on constant drifts and ultralight dark-matter couplings). The two-person allocation is uncontested and the citation is scoped to invention and realisation rather than prospective applications. I tested this against the chair's own caution that unanimity after round-1 movement is not evidence, and it still clearly beats no award.
